_comment: Combo numbers. The multiplier multiplies all XP. Proposed numbers; the board judges them in playtests. Multiplier 1.0 means no combo. collision_cut and drain_wait_seconds are decided (Game loop architecture, Decisions).

trick_subs._comment: T-513 (Game loop architecture, Decisions, "Back to the combo multiplier; tricks pay subs"): the subs (XP, the same as the run's levels use) each trick pays straight away, on top of raising the multiplier. Proposals for the playtest. One drift second is 10 subs at x1 and the first level needs 30, so a 360 (5) is half a drift second and the big tricks (10) a whole one. extended_drift and airtime are 0: the drift already pays its subs by the second (run.json drift_xp_per_second) and the airtime trick is a small, frequent hop; raise them here to make them pay too. multiplied_by_combo: true multiplies the subs by the multiplier as it stood just before the trick raised it (like the drift's subs, so a high combo makes every trick worth more, and the first trick of a combo pays plain); false pays the flat number.

thread_the_needle._comment: T-272, proposals for the playtest (Level design, Decisions, "Thread the needle"). Worth (trick_add.thread_the_needle): 0.5, as ALT DRIFT! and AIR 360!, twice a FULL 360!, since it needs a line aimed through a gap the board placed. repeat_seconds: the same pair pays again on a later pass in either direction, once this long has gone by since it last paid, so weaving back and forth over the line does not pay every crossing. counts_in_air: a pass in the air (a jump through the gap) counts too; the car can't fly over the obstacles themselves, since a car in the air crashes into them as on the ground. touch_window_seconds and clear_seconds: a touch of either obstacle in the window before the car crosses the line, or until clear_seconds after it, voids the pass (the crash cuts the combo as always); the trick pays clear_seconds after the crossing.

reverse_drift._comment: T-536, proposals for the playtest (Drifting, Decisions, "A reverse drift trick"; Content, "Reverse drift and aura (task T-536)"). A drift on S without W while the car moves backwards (velocity behind the nose) pays REVERSE DRIFT! once per unbroken reverse drift, when it has lasted min_seconds. 1.0 s, as the shortest drift that pays (drift_pay.min_seconds), so a tap of S + A/D does not pay. Worth (trick_add.reverse_drift 0.25, trick_subs.reverse_drift 5): as FULL 360! and AIR 180!, half of ALT DRIFT!, since it needs only one held key pair.

aura._comment: T-536, proposals for the playtest (Drifting, Decisions, "An aura trick"). still_speed: the car counts as still at or under this speed in units/s (cruise speed is 11; with no keys it coasts to 0 in about a second), so a stopped car counts and a rolling one does not. wait_seconds (5, the board's) still before it starts; then one AURA FARMING! every every_seconds (1, the board's), the first at 6 s. Moving above still_speed or leaving the ground starts the count again. Worth per aura (trick_add.aura 0.1, trick_subs.aura 2): small, since it repeats every second with no skill: 2 subs is a fifth of a drift second, and 0.1 keeps the combo from draining and climbs it slowly (about 50 s still from x1 to x6) while the enemies close in.

drift_pay._comment: A whole drift pays once, when it ends (Drifting, Decisions, T-246): seconds of drift times per_second, nothing under min_seconds, at most max. Proposals for the playtest.

hype_speed._comment: The hype speed boost (T-275, Drifting, Decisions): the car's top speed (and so its acceleration, as the time to top speed stays) is this much above the base at combo heat step 1, 2 and 3 (ComboHeat.THRESHOLDS: x2, x3, x4 and up); none below x2. The bonus eases towards the step's amount by ease_per_second (0.2 = a full 0.16 in 0.8 s). Proposals for the playtest.

_crash_pays_trick_first_comment: T-315 (Game loop architecture, Decisions, "A crash pays the trick in progress"): a crash pays the trick in progress (a drift so far, an airtime and air spins so far). true: the trick pays first, then the crash cuts the combo, so its popup shows just before COMBO BROKEN! (the board approved this order for the playtest). false: the cut comes first, then the trick is added to the cut combo (worth more to the player).
_collision_window_comment: T-415 (Game loop architecture, Decisions, "Hits close together cut the combo once"): a collision within this many seconds of the one that cut the combo does not cut it again. 0.5 s is a proposal for the playtest; 0 turns the window off.
